inputs: read-only copy of the canonical DuckDB of the snapshot; VECTOR_PATHS_JSON artifacts (read only); source PDFs of PRIVATE (read only); nothing written to the canon, CORE or EDGE

criteria.chartlike: >= 6 numeric tokens within 15 pt of the figure box and >= 20 'l'/'c' items in VECTOR_PATHS_JSON
criteria.core_keyword: caption or page matches one of: subsidence, trough, profile_line, benchmark, convergence, levelling, displacement (keyword names only; regexes in figures/discover.py)

route_b_vertex_fidelity.definition: share of DXF vertices inside the figure crop that lie within 0.15 pt of a vertex of the PDF page's paths (PyMuPDF get_drawings, 'l'/'c'/'re'/'qu' items); 320 DXF of the sweep
route_b_vertex_fidelity.multi_piece_spline_knots: all interior knots of multiplicity 2 (C1 joins); none in Bezier form (multiplicity 3)
route_b_vertex_fidelity.same_cubic_test: a C1/C2/C3 same-cubic test at the joints (tolerance 1e-4 relative) marks 16 of 3139 joints and does not separate PDF vertices from subdivision points: the pieces approximate the PDF curve to about 0.01 pt
route_b_vertex_fidelity.policy: route B keeps only the end points of multi-piece splines and flags the series SPLINE_INTERIOR_NOT_RECOVERED (fd-0.1.1); fd-0.1.0 had flattened them into curve samples

route_agreement_matched_series.definition: series matched by label or colour; max over points of the distance to the nearest point of the other route, normalised by the figure-wide x and y spans

parse_seconds_per_figure.note: B excludes the AutoCAD import (see route_b_import)
